name: RelyEZ Energy Storage Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: RelyEZ Energy Storage Technology Co., Ltd. research and development, production, and sale of integrated energy storage system solutions and provides related integrated solutions and services in China and internationally. It offers the GridUltra series ESS containers available in liquid-cooled and liquid-immersed versions. It also provides integrated ESS solutions through its VenturePro series liquid-cooled ESS cabinets. The company also offers ESS hardware products, including GridUltra containers, VenturePro cabinets, RelyEZ battery packs, and RelyEZ battery racks.
